description_en: Queries the Operation and Maintenance (O&M) task configuration for a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例的运维任务配置
name: DescribeActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task configuration was created. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

CycleTime.description_en:
The days of the cycle.

If CycleType is set to Month, this parameter returns the days of the month. Valid values: 1 to 28. Multiple values are separated by commas (,).

If CycleType is set to Week, this parameter returns the days of the week. Valid values: 1 to 7. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
CycleTime.description_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接

CycleType.description_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O\&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口结束时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O\&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口开始时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the operations and maintenance (O\&M) task configuration was modified. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration is enabled.

1: Enabled

2: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
配置是否生效。

1 生效
2 无效

HasConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether a configuration is set.

1: A configuration is set.

0: No configuration is set
HasConfig.description_zh:
是否已配置：

1：已经配置；
0：未配置
